## Before you open this

- [ ] No coordinates of a site or a find anywhere in the change, the description or screenshots.
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q` passes; `cd app && swift build && swift test` passes if the app changed.
- [ ] If a prompt, the skill, the feature guide or how finds are made changed: smoke test and blind tests rerun, and no worse.
- [ ] README, HANDOFF and the loop log updated if a person will notice the change.
- [ ] Only people are credited: no AI listed as an author or co-author, and no "Generated with" line. Saying in words that you used AI is fine.
